tutorial.info: Quadrille is a four-player trick-taking game on a 40-card Spanish deck (no 8/9/10). All 40 cards are dealt, ten each, so there is no stock. A bid phase (pass / entrar / solo) plus a chosen trump suit decides the Quadrille, who then **calls the King of a suit they do not hold**; whoever holds it becomes a temporary partner. The called suit is public, but **the holder stays hidden until that King is played**. Holding all four Kings forces a solo hand (Roi seul) against the other three. Trump ranking is Spadille (♠A) > Manille (the 7 of trump) > Basto (♣A) > Punto (the Ace of a red trump) > K > Q > J > 6..2. The ten tricks are compared side against side — Sacar (ahead) scores, Puesta (tied) penalises, Codille (behind) doubles the penalty. The highest cumulative score after the set number of deals wins the match.
